contract_beast_of_white_orchard.name: Beast of White Orchard
contract_beast_of_white_orchard.short_description: A griffin has been terrorizing the fields near the Ismena River.
contract_beast_of_white_orchard.description: A Griffin has made its nest near the fields south of the Ismena River. It has been preying on livestock and even attacked a patrol. Villagers are offering a handsome reward for slaying the beast and bringing proof of the kill.

contract_drowners_by_the_old_mill.name: Drowners by the Old Mill
contract_drowners_by_the_old_mill.short_description: Drowners lurking near the old mill are scaring the fishermen away.
contract_drowners_by_the_old_mill.description: Several drowners have been sighted along the riverbank near the old mill. Fishermen fear to go near the water after dusk. The village elder seeks someone skilled enough to cleanse the area of the monsters.

contract_song_beneath_the_river.name: Song Beneath the River
contract_song_beneath_the_river.short_description: Sailors report eerie songs luring them toward the river cliffs.
contract_song_beneath_the_river.description: Sailors traveling the Ismena River report eerie singing that lures them toward the rocks at night. Those who follow never return. The locals suspect a group of sirens nesting near the river cliffs. A reward is offered for their heads.

contract_devil_by_the_well.name: Devil by the well
contract_devil_by_the_well.short_description: Villagers of the Abandoned Village claim a vengeful spirit haunts the old well, dragging the living to their deaths.
contract_devil_by_the_well.description: Villagers report a restless spirit by the old well. It attacks anyone who ventures too close. The elders promise a reward for lifting the curse. None dare fetch water or till the nearby fields, for the ghost's wailing is heard at dawn and dusk. Any witcher brave enough to face the spirit shall be paid 300 crowns upon proof of the wraith’s defeat.

contract_leshen_in_crookback_bog.name: Leshen in Crookback Bog
contract_leshen_in_crookback_bog.short_description: A Leshen has been seen drawing beasts to trample the peat bogs.
contract_leshen_in_crookback_bog.description: Locals report an ancient Leshen has returned and is calling animals and roots to protect its domain. Pack animal routes have been destroyed and the farmers fear for their livestock.

contract_wyvern_nest_at_crows_perch.name: Wyvern Nest at Crow's Perch
contract_wyvern_nest_at_crows_perch.short_description: A wyvern nesting in the high cliffs has started raiding nearby farms.
contract_wyvern_nest_at_crows_perch.description: Farmers report missing livestock and a large, dragon-like shadow seen circling the cliffs near Crow's Perch. Bring proof of the wyvern's defeat.

contract_sewer_beast.name: Sewer Beast
contract_sewer_beast.short_description: Creatures have taken up residence in the old Novigrad sewers.
contract_sewer_beast.description: Sewer workers unearthed signs of small, aggressive beasts living beneath Novigrad. Civilians have seen shadowy figures near the drains at night.

contract_waves_of_the_wyvern.name: Waves of the Wyvern
contract_waves_of_the_wyvern.short_description: A wyvern has nested near a coastal village and attacks passing ships.
contract_waves_of_the_wyvern.description: Villagers report a fierce wyvern nesting atop a coastal stack, swooping down to plunder ships and livestock. The chieftain offers coin for its head.

contract_spirits_of_the_standing_stones.name: Spirits of the Standing Stones
contract_spirits_of_the_standing_stones.short_description: A restless specter haunts the ancient standing stones.
contract_spirits_of_the_standing_stones.description: Islanders whisper of a noonwraith that appears near the old standing stones. Farmers report terrified cattle and a chilling wail at midday.

contract_griffin_school_gear.name: Scavenger Hunt: Griffin School Gear
contract_griffin_school_gear.short_description: Hunt down a flock of griffins to recover the lost diagrams of the Griffin School.
contract_griffin_school_gear.description: A famous Witcher of the Griffin School was lost in these parts years ago. His gear diagrams are said to be scattered in a mountain pass now guarded by a vicious flock of griffins. Clear out 8 of the beasts to safely recover the steel and silver sword crafting recipes.

contract_feline_school_gear.name: Scavenger Hunt: Feline School Gear
contract_feline_school_gear.short_description: Clear out an alghoul nest to retrieve Cat School diagrams.
contract_feline_school_gear.description: An old expedition carrying Cat School sword diagrams was overrun by necrophages near some elven ruins. Slay 8 alghouls infesting the area to reclaim the lost feline sword recipes.

contract_ursine_school_gear.name: Scavenger Hunt: Bear School Gear
contract_ursine_school_gear.short_description: Hunt down massive bears in the high peaks to find Ursine School gear.
contract_ursine_school_gear.description: The heavy, devastating swords of the Bear School are hidden in a cave system deep in the mountains. Survive the harsh environment by hunting 10 territorial bears to secure the diagrams.

contract_wolven_school_gear.name: Scavenger Hunt: Wolf School Gear
contract_wolven_school_gear.short_description: Survive a massive wolf pack to uncover Kaer Morhen's ancient diagrams.
contract_wolven_school_gear.description: Old diagrams belonging to the School of the Wolf were dropped near a dense forest during a rout. A massive pack of wolves has claimed the area. Thin their numbers by hunting 15 wolves to retrieve your school's sword recipes.

contract_viper_school_gear.name: Scavenger Hunt: Viper School Gear
contract_viper_school_gear.short_description: Retrieve the lost Viper School diagrams from an insectoid-infested cellar.
contract_viper_school_gear.description: An assassin from the School of the Viper was cornered in an old cellar centuries ago. The area is now a breeding ground for Endrega Warriors. Slay the insectoids to recover the lethal twin blade diagrams left behind.

contract_the_soldiers_elixir.name: The Soldier's Elixir
contract_the_soldiers_elixir.short_description: Clear the battlefield of ghouls to recover a medic's potion formula.
contract_the_soldiers_elixir.description: A field medic lost their satchel during a skirmish in Velen. The bodies have attracted a pack of starving ghouls. Clear the scavengers away to claim the Swallow potion recipe hidden inside the medic's bag.

contract_blood_in_the_swamp.name: Blood in the Swamp
contract_blood_in_the_swamp.short_description: Hunt the illusion-casting foglets to find an alchemist's remains.
contract_blood_in_the_swamp.description: An alchemist venturing into the swamps seeking rare herbs was ambushed by foglets. Slay the deceptive necrophages to recover his upgraded formula for the Enhanced Swallow potion.

contract_the_apex_predator.name: The Apex Predator
contract_the_apex_predator.short_description: Slay a brutal lower vampire to claim the ultimate healing formula.
contract_the_apex_predator.description: An Ekimmara has made its lair in the old ruins, hoarding the belongings of its countless victims. Among the bones lies an ancient Witcher cache containing the formula for Superior Swallow. Bring the beast down.

contract_highway_robbery.name: Highway Robbery
contract_highway_robbery.short_description: Eliminate a massive bandit camp to secure a lethal blade oil.
contract_highway_robbery.description: A ruthless gang of bandits has blocked the main trade route, extorting merchants and killing those who resist. Wipe out their camp to find the recipe for Hanged Man's Venom among their stolen loot.

contract_cleansing_the_graveyard.name: Cleansing the Graveyard
contract_cleansing_the_graveyard.short_description: Eradicate the spiked necrophages digging up the local cemetery.
contract_cleansing_the_graveyard.description: The village graveyard has been completely overrun by Alghouls. The local priest offers a bounty and access to the church's hidden archives, containing the formula for Necrophage Oil, to whoever purges the holy ground.

contract_the_restless_maidens.name: The Restless Maidens
contract_the_restless_maidens.short_description: Banish the vengeful spirits haunting the executioner's tree.
contract_the_restless_maidens.description: Wraiths have gathered around Hanged Man's Tree, their anguished wails driving nearby settlers mad. Banish the specters to uncover a hidden stash at the base of the tree containing the recipe for Specter Oil.

contract_winged_death.name: Winged Death
contract_winged_death.short_description: Take down a mated pair of wyverns terrorizing the high cliffs.
contract_winged_death.description: Two wyverns have claimed the rocky peaks, dropping sheep and sometimes shepherds from the sky. Hunt them both down. As an added bonus, you'll find the recipe for Draconid Oil in the remains of a previous, less successful Witcher.

contract_terror_of_the_woods.name: Terror of the Woods
contract_terror_of_the_woods.short_description: Cull the overly aggressive bears blocking the logging camp.
contract_terror_of_the_woods.description: The lumberjacks cannot do their jobs because the woods are teeming with massive, starving bears. Thin their numbers so work can resume, and you'll find the formula for Beast Oil in the abandoned foreman's cabin.

contract_the_screeching_cliffs.name: The Screeching Cliffs
contract_the_screeching_cliffs.short_description: Clear the coastal cliffs of a massive harpy infestation.
contract_the_screeching_cliffs.description: A flock of harpies has built nests along the vital coastal paths, diving at anyone who tries to pass. Eradicate the flock and search their filthy nests to uncover the recipe for Hybrid Oil.

contract_shadow_of_the_bits.name: Shadow of the Bits
contract_shadow_of_the_bits.short_description: A ruthless gang is extorting the poorest residents in the slums of Novigrad.
contract_shadow_of_the_bits.description: The City Guard refuses to patrol the impoverished district known as The Bits. A violent gang of bandits has taken over the alleys, shaking down the locals. Clear out the thugs to make the streets safe again.

contract_temple_isle_menace.name: Temple Isle Menace
contract_temple_isle_menace.short_description: Corrupt Witch Hunters are executing innocent herbalists on Temple Isle.
contract_temple_isle_menace.description: Under the guise of serving the Eternal Fire, a rogue squadron of Witch Hunters has been seizing property and executing harmless merchants on Temple Isle. Ambush the patrol and put an end to their fanaticism. You may find the formula for Elementa Oil among their confiscated contraband.

contract_the_cemetery_stalker.name: The Cemetery Stalker
contract_the_cemetery_stalker.short_description: Necrophages are digging up the graves of wealthy nobles.
contract_the_cemetery_stalker.description: The gravedigger of Novigrad Cemetery is terrified. A pack of spiked alghouls has broken into the noble crypts and is feasting on the recently deceased. Eradicate the beasts before the city catches wind of the desecration.

contract_phantom_of_farcorners.name: Phantom of Farcorners
contract_phantom_of_farcorners.short_description: A spectral figure haunts the farmlands just outside the city walls.
contract_phantom_of_farcorners.description: Farmers in the Farcorners district are abandoning their crops because a weeping spirit appears in the fields at midday, turning anyone who approaches into dried husks. Banish the Noonwraith so the city doesn't starve.
